name: stream-graph
title: Stream Graph
description: Layered streams on a centred baseline that morph between datasets; tap a layer to lift it and read its share.

perf.budget: One Skia canvas, one path per layer; a morph interpolates the paths on the UI thread. Shapes are built once per dataset. Nothing runs at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: New data replaces the shapes at once; isolating a layer still fades the others.
a11y.screenReader: The graph is an image that reads each layer's total; each key is a button with a selected state.
a11y.touchTarget: The keys are 44 pt tall; the whole graph can be tapped.
